title: SmartPlay
triage_note: Foundational multi-game agent benchmark for rule-grounded evaluation, capability decomposition, and textified interface trade-offs.

title: BotzoneBench: Scalable LLM Evaluation via Graded AI Anchors
triage_note: Anchor for scalable protocol design with fixed AI skill tiers across games.

title: Beyond Scaling: Assessing Strategic Reasoning and Rapid Decision-Making Capability of LLMs in Zero-sum Environments
triage_note: Useful contrast on zero-sum strategy, protocol-mediated play, and real-time pressure in a narrow arena design.

title: LLM CHESS: Benchmarking Reasoning and Instruction-Following in LLMs through Chess
triage_note: Representative single-game probe for legal action, privileged tool access, and instruction-following under chess rules.

title: Game Reasoning Arena: A Framework and Benchmark for Assessing Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models via Game Play
triage_note: Broad OpenSpiel-based framework for cross-game strategic comparison, prompt-interface analysis, and reasoning-trace inspection.

title: Werewolf Arena
triage_note: Anchor for social deduction and deceptive multi-agent evaluation with partial observability.

title: WOLF: Werewolf-based Observations for LLM Deception and Falsehoods
triage_note: Direct follow-on benchmark separating deception generation from deception detection in Werewolf.

title: Beyond Survival: Evaluating LLMs in Social Deduction Games with Human-Aligned Strategies
triage_note: Human-grounded social deduction benchmark built from Panda Kill; strongest as an offline reference-alignment contrast rather than a live-agent benchmark.

title: LLM-Hanabi: Evaluating Multi-Agent Gameplays with Theory-of-Mind and Rationale Inference in Imperfect Information Collaboration Game
triage_note: Cooperative imperfect-information benchmark for theory-of-mind and rationale inference.

title: Is Your LLM Really Mastering the Concept? A Multi-Agent Benchmark
triage_note: Contrast case for concept use through Undercover-style multi-agent play; strongest as a Section 2/3 contrast rather than a core social benchmark anchor.

title: Multicultural Spyfall: Assessing LLMs through Dynamic Multilingual Social Deduction Game
triage_note: Multilingual Spyfall benchmark for non-English and cultural-stress effects in social deduction, especially beyond English-only evaluation.

title: Sparks of Cooperative Reasoning: LLMs as Strategic Hanabi Agents
triage_note: Representative cooperative Hanabi benchmark for scaffold sensitivity, self-play versus cross-play, and benchmark-plus-training-resource design.

title: BALROG
triage_note: Core visual-agent benchmark bridging ecological play and interface design.

title: GameplayQA: A Benchmarking Framework for Decision-Dense POV-Synced Multi-Video Understanding of 3D Virtual Agents
triage_note: Dense first-person multi-video perception benchmark for agentic state tracking and temporal grounding.

title: GameVerse: Can VLMs Learn from Video-based Reflection?
triage_note: Cross-game VLM benchmark with reflect-and-retry loops and milestone evaluation.

title: StarBench: A Turn-Based RPG Benchmark for Agentic Multimodal Decision-Making and Information Seeking
triage_note: Strong GUI benchmark for pixel-to-action control and ask-or-act information seeking.

title: FlashAdventure: A Benchmark for GUI Agents Solving Full Story Arcs in Diverse Adventure Games
triage_note: Long-horizon GUI benchmark centered on full story completion and memory-dependent play.

title: OpenGuanDan: A Large-Scale Imperfect Information Game Benchmark
triage_note: Specialized imperfect-information card benchmark with built-in GuanDan agents, pairwise AI-vs-AI evaluation, and limited human-AI calibration.

title: CATArena: Evaluation of LLM Agents through Iterative Tournament
triage_note: Contrast case for code-agent tournament evaluation, iterative peer learning, and variant-based non-saturation; not direct-play evidence.

title: Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?
triage_note: Training-heavy card-game suite for transfer, retention, and teacher-data evaluation; useful contrast rather than ecological benchmark.

title: Who is a Better Player: LLM against LLM
triage_note: Pool-dependent LLM-vs-LLM board-game arena useful for Elo/PLG methodology contrast and ranking-instability cautions.

title: PillagerBench: Benchmarking LLM-Based Agents in Competitive Minecraft Team Environments
triage_note: Competitive Minecraft benchmark with built-in opponents and persistent cross-episode learning; ecological contrast despite structured API access.

title: AI GAMESTORE: Scalable, Open-Ended Evaluation of Machine General Intelligence with Human Games
triage_note: Open-ended platform vision for evaluating human-like general intelligence across human games.

title: GVGAI-LLM: Evaluating Large Language Model Agents with Infinite Games
triage_note: General video game benchmark with procedural breadth and reproducible ASCII state interfaces.

title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale
triage_note: Competition-scale benchmark for long-context opponent modeling in Pokemon battles. [uncertain: historical-placement]

title: PuzzlePlex: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Reasoning and Planning with Puzzles
triage_note: Broad puzzle suite useful for planning and generalization contrasts beyond social or ecological games.

title: Orak: A Foundational Benchmark for Training and Evaluating LLM Agents on 12-Genre Video Games
triage_note: Genre-diverse train-and-eval benchmark bridging benchmark suites and cross-game generalization.

title: MCU: An Evaluation Framework for Open-Ended Game Agents
triage_note: Open-ended Minecraft benchmark with task composition and human-aligned evaluation.

title: Benchmarking the Spectrum of Agent Capabilities
triage_note: Crafter is a foundational single-environment general-capability benchmark and precursor for later game-agent suites.

title: TowerMind: A Tower Defence Game Learning Environment and Benchmark for LLM as Agents
triage_note: Tower-defense environment adds real-time multimodal control and hallucination-oriented diagnostics.

title: DeepPHY: Benchmarking Agentic VLMs on Physical Reasoning
triage_note: Physical reasoning benchmark overlaps with game-like control but fit to the survey remains partly indirect. [uncertain: scope]

title: Reasoning via Video: The First Evaluation of Video Models' Reasoning Abilities through Maze-Solving Tasks
triage_note: Video maze benchmark isolates temporal visual reasoning more than full agent play. [uncertain: scope]

title: EvoEmpirBench: Dynamic Spatial Reasoning with Agent-ExpVer
triage_note: Dynamic maze-style benchmark is useful for spatial reasoning comparison but narrow in survey scope. [uncertain: scope]

title: EMemBench: Interactive Benchmarking of Episodic Memory for VLM Agents
triage_note: Interactive game-based episodic-memory benchmark for VLM agents that sharpens the memory diagnostic branch.

title: GTBench: Uncovering the Strategic Reasoning Limitations of LLMs via Game-Theoretic Evaluations
triage_note: Game-theoretic task design and LLM-vs-LLM evaluation make it a core formal reasoning anchor.

title: GameBench: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Abilities of LLM Agents
triage_note: Cross-domain strategy benchmark spanning multiple games and prompting setups.

title: How Far Are We on the Decision-Making of LLMs? Evaluating LLMs' Gaming Ability in Multi-Agent Environments
triage_note: Multi-agent decision benchmark grounded in game-theoretic settings and prompting variants.

title: TMGBench: A Systematic Game Benchmark for Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Abilities of LLMs
triage_note: Broad strategic benchmark useful for taxonomy coverage though overlap with earlier suites is high.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models with Grid-Based Game Competitions: An Extensible LLM Benchmark and Leaderboard
triage_note: Simple grid-game leaderboard benchmark that fits as a controlled strategic precursor.

title: LMGAME-BENCH: How Good are LLMs at Playing Games?
triage_note: Unified game benchmark with explicit perception and memory breakdowns for agent evaluation.

title: GAMEBoT: Transparent Assessment of LLM Reasoning in Games
triage_note: Transparent subproblem decomposition clarifies process metrics beyond raw win rate.

title: KORGym: A Dynamic Game Platform for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
triage_note: Dynamic multi-game platform broadening benchmark coverage and evaluation protocol variation.

title: LLMs as Rules Oracles: Exploring Real-World Multimodal Reasoning in Tabletop Strategy Game Environments
triage_note: Contrast paper for multimodal rule-grounding in real tabletop games; strongest for rulebook integration and interface-design discussion rather than live gameplay claims.

title: TextArena
triage_note: Competitive text-game suite with online-play ratings that broadens benchmark-platform discussion.

title: clembench: Using Game Play to Evaluate Chat-Optimized Language Models as Conversational Agents
triage_note: Dialogue-game evaluation framework that broadens benchmark instrumentation beyond win rate and static task instances.

title: clembench-2024: A Challenging, Dynamic, Complementary, Multilingual Benchmark and Underlying Flexible Framework for LLMs as Multi-Action Agents
triage_note: Framework expansion that adds multilingual and multi-action dialogue games to the clembench line.

title: A Third Paradigm for LLM Evaluation: Dialogue Game-Based Evaluation using clembench
triage_note: Meta-evaluation framing paper that helps position dialogue games against static and arena-style evaluation.

title: VideoGameBench: Can VLM Complete Popular Video Games?
triage_note: Raw-visual real-time benchmark is a strong ecological comparison target for BALROG.

title: V-MAGE: A Game Evaluation Framework for Assessing Visual-Centric Agentic Foundation Models
triage_note: Visual-centric agent benchmark with Elo-style evaluation across dynamic game interactions.

title: Are Large Vision-Language Models Good Game Players?
triage_note: Early visual-game comparison set useful as a historical baseline for later ecological work.

title: ING-VP: MLLMs cannot Play Easy Vision-based Games Yet
triage_note: Vision-game benchmark highlighting spatial planning limits under light scaffolding.

title: Atari-GPT: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models as Low-Level Policies in Atari Games
triage_note: Atari low-level control benchmark probes reaction latency and perception under multimodal policies.

title: TextQuests: How Good are LLMs at Text-Based Video Games?
triage_note: Interactive fiction benchmark stressing textual exploration memory and long-context action selection.

title: TextAtari: 100K Frames Game Playing with Language Agents
triage_note: Textified Atari benchmark links compact language state to very long control horizons.

title: StarDojo: Benchmarking Open-Ended Behaviors of Agentic Multimodal LLMs in Production-Living Simulations with Stardew Valley
triage_note: Production-living simulation benchmark expanding open-ended multimodal behavior and long-horizon evaluation.

title: CivRealm: A Learning and Reasoning Odyssey in Civilization for Decision-Making Agents
triage_note: Civilization environment bridging strategic planning long horizons and generalization across settings.

title: Mars: Situated Inductive Reasoning in an Open-World Environment
triage_note: Open-world situated reasoning environment is useful for embodied comparison but only partly benchmark-centric. [uncertain: scope]

title: MineNPC-Task: Task Suite for Memory-Aware Minecraft Agents
triage_note: Minecraft task suite centered on memory-aware mixed-initiative play, useful for the long-horizon memory discussion.

title: Interactive Fiction Games: A Colossal Adventure
triage_note: Highly cited text-game precursor and Jericho anchor for the survey's taxonomy and lineage discussion.

title: The NetHack Learning Environment
triage_note: Foundational hard game environment for long-horizon, partial-observability, and general-agent discussions.

title: PuzzleJAX: A Benchmark for Reasoning and Learning
triage_note: PuzzleScript-to-JAX puzzle family best used as a symbolic benchmark-space contrast on rule transfer, deadlock reasoning, and overfitting-resistant task breadth rather than ecological play.

title: Sudoku-Bench: Evaluating creative reasoning with Sudoku variants
triage_note: Tool-free text benchmark for creative Sudoku break-ins; best used as a symbolic reasoning contrast and for separating intrinsic reasoning from optional tool-use tracks.

title: CrossWordBench: Evaluating the Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs and LVLMs with Controllable Puzzle Generation
triage_note: Generated crossword benchmark best used as a structural-constraint contrast on LLM-vs-LVLM reasoning, grid consistency, and perception-versus-reasoning failure separation.

title: VGRP-Bench: Visual Grid Reasoning Puzzle Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
triage_note: Visual grid puzzle benchmark best used as a multimodal diagnostic contrast on perception-versus-reasoning failures and weak post-training generalization, not as full visual-agent evidence.

title: MazeEval: Maze Navigation Benchmark
triage_note: Coordinate-only maze benchmark with full visit-history support; best used as a compact contrast on sequential spatial reasoning, looping failure, and language dependence.

title: GameTraversalBenchmark: Evaluating Planning Abilities Of Large Language Models Through Traversing 2D Game Maps
triage_note: Generated 2D map traversal benchmark best used as a symbolic planning contrast on multi-objective routing, generation-control errors, and near-miss scoring rather than broad game competence.

title: ARC-AGI-3: A New Challenge for Frontier Agentic Intelligence
triage_note: Official ARC-AGI-3 paper is best used as an interactive benchmark-design contrast on human-normalized efficiency, private holdouts, and harness-versus-general-agent evaluation policy.

title: AvalonBench: Evaluating LLMs Playing the Game of Avalon
triage_note: Early prompt-mediated social-deduction benchmark with naive-bot baselines; strongest as a historical contrast rather than an ecological anchor.

title: DSGBench: A Diverse Strategic Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-based Agents in Complex Decision-Making Environments
triage_note: Genre-diverse strategic suite with unified text interfaces, fine-grained capability metrics, and trajectory logging; broad diagnostic platform rather than a full generalization benchmark.

title: TeamCraft: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Systems in Minecraft
triage_note: Minecraft multimodal multi-agent benchmark with MineFlayer-backed high-level skills and Goal/Scene/Agents generalization splits; strong for visual collaboration, not cross-game transfer.

title: GameArena: Evaluating LLM Reasoning Through Live Computer Games
triage_note: Live human-game benchmark with retrospective reasoning analysis and far higher useful-session yield than chat arenas.

title: Collab-Overcooked: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Language Models as Collaborative Agents
triage_note: Forced-collaboration Overcooked benchmark with text-state interaction and PC/IC/RC-style process metrics; strong for cooperation analysis rather than ecological play.

title: Human-level play in the game of Diplomacy by combining language models with strategic reasoning
triage_note: Anchor milestone for negotiation-heavy play and ecological human evaluation; use for language-plus-planning and comparability trade-offs rather than as a standardized benchmark protocol.

title: LLM-Coordination: Evaluating and Analyzing Multi-agent Coordination Abilities in Large Language Models
triage_note: Pure-coordination benchmark with text-state, scaffolded agentic play plus CoordQA; strongest for the split between environment reasoning, partner modeling, and unseen-partner robustness.

title: PokerBench: Training Large Language Models to become Professional Poker Players
triage_note: Solver-grounded poker spot benchmark plus training set; useful contrast for specialist calibration and for the gap between cheap diagnostic evaluation and live match play.

title: Complete Chess Games Enable LLM Become A Chess Master
triage_note: Chess-specialized training and evaluation paper using FEN-to-move supervision and Stockfish games; useful contrast on rule grounding, abstract interfaces, and static-versus-actual-game evaluation.

title: PokéChamp: an Expert-level Minimax Language Agent
triage_note: Pokemon specialist system paper with rich offline and live evaluation; useful contrast on LLM-plus-search design under partial observability and strict time budgets.

title: Large Language Models Play StarCraft II: Benchmarks and A Chain of Summarization Approach
triage_note: Early StarCraft II benchmark establishing the text-interface macro-RTS lineage for LLM agents and CoS-style history compression.

title: StarCraft II Arena: Evaluating LLMs in Strategic Planning, Real-Time Decision Making, and Adaptability
triage_note: Specialist RTS benchmark useful for fine-grained metric design, sync-vs-async comparison, and decision tracing; cite interface details narrowly because the implementation description remains thin.

title: VLMs Play StarCraft II: A Benchmark and Multimodal Decision Method
triage_note: Multimodal StarCraft II benchmark extending the RTS line into visual tactical decision-making and componentized VLM control.

title: Mixing Expert Knowledge: Bring Human Thoughts Back To the Game of Go
triage_note: Go-specialist training-and-evaluation paper useful as a boundary case for structured expert-data injection and benchmark-level upper bounds.

title: GTO Wizard Benchmark
triage_note: Standardized poker benchmark with a fixed superhuman anchor and AIVAT variance reduction, useful for specialist calibration comparisons.
